fields.summary_ko.0: Alphabet's Google Cloud now allows TPU (Tensor Processing Unit) chips to be installed in customers' on-premise data centers, with nearly 100 customers currently using them; current stock price near $292 versus all-time high of $402.62, representing a 28% decline.
fields.summary_ko.1: Google Cloud Q3 revenue more than doubled year-over-year to $30.7 billion, backlog (unrecognized contract revenue) reached $561 billion, and operating margin expanded from 23.7% to 36.2%.
